## Research experience

**Undergraduate Researcher** — PLACEHOLDER: Lab / Department, Jeonbuk National University \
PLACEHOLDER: start date – present

- Cross-country transfer learning for ICU admission prediction from multi-country
  electronic health records, using TabPFN with target-domain adaptation, and
  assessing sensitivity of the results to label noise.

**Undergraduate Researcher** — UNLV EIP (Project 4), University of Nevada, Las Vegas \
June – July 2025

- Predicted patient mortality from irregularly sampled EHR vital-sign sequences
  in a four-person team, comparing linear and non-linear interpolation across CNN
  and LSTM architectures; responsible for the linear-interpolation + LSTM arm.
- Faculty: Dr. Mingon Kang.

**Undergraduate Research Assistant** — Department of Statistics, Jeonbuk National University \
PLACEHOLDER: dates

- Applied neural Granger causality (component-wise MLP and LSTM) to a year of
  hourly meteorological observations to identify predictors of solar radiation,
  benchmarked against a linear VAR.
- Co-authored a PROSPERO-registered systematic review and meta-analysis of
  randomized trials of digital cognitive training in dementia.
